name: Sun Totem, Lesser
source: Qadira, Jewel of the East pg. 29
body:
Sun Totem, Lesser (Su)
Source Qadira, Jewel of the East pg. 29
The sun’s fire invigorates the barbarian. She is immune to environmental effects from heat and severe heat, and she gains a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves against the effects of extreme heat. In addition, the barbarian gains fire resistance 5 while raging.
